Container.Name: Posteryard
Container.Overview: Clean, consistent posters for Plex and Jellyfin, picked, rendered and kept current automatically.[br][br]Posteryard gives every movie, show, season and episode the same calm look: clean art without printed text, the title logo in one fixed spot, a soft fade, and small badges for 4K, Dolby Vision, Dolby Atmos and the streaming service. It finds the art on TMDB, checks it, renders it, uploads it and keeps it up to date.[br][br]It starts with Dry Run on: images go to the previews folder in Data and the server is not touched. Set Dry Run to false when you like them.[br][br]For new titles right away, add a webhook in Plex under Settings, Webhooks: http://UNRAID-IP:8000/webhook/YOUR-WEBHOOK-SECRET. Without it, new titles get posters within 15 minutes.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: plex jellyfin posters artwork tmdb kometa textless
Container.DonateText: If Posteryard is useful to you, you can buy me a coffee.

Config.Name: Webhook Port
Config.Description: Port for the Plex or Jellyfin webhook and the /healthz check.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Database, previews and custom art. Keep this, or every image is rendered and uploaded again.

Config.Name: TMDB API Key
Config.Description: A free key from themoviedb.org, under Settings, API.

Config.Name: Plex URL
Config.Description: Address of your Plex server, such as http://192.168.1.10:32400. Leave empty for Jellyfin.

Config.Name: Plex Token
Config.Description: Your Plex token. Leave empty for Jellyfin.

Config.Name: Webhook Secret
Config.Description: Any long random text. It is part of the webhook address.

Config.Name: Dry Run
Config.Description: true saves previews to the previews folder in Data and leaves the server alone. false uploads.

Config.Name: Libraries
Config.Description: Libraries to manage, by their exact names, separated by commas.

Config.Name: Streaming Regions
Config.Description: Two-letter country codes to look up a show's streaming service in, in order, such as CA,US.

Config.Name: Notify URLs
Config.Description: Apprise addresses for alerts, separated by spaces, such as discord://ID/TOKEN or ntfys://tk_TOKEN@host/topic.

Config.Name: Jellyfin URL
Config.Description: Address of your Jellyfin server. Use instead of Plex URL and Plex Token.

Config.Name: Jellyfin API Key
Config.Description: A Jellyfin API key, from Dashboard, API Keys.

Config.Name: Maintainerr URL
Config.Description: Your Maintainerr address, for the Leaving in N days label.

Config.Name: fanart.tv API Key
Config.Description: Optional second art source when TMDB has no clean art.

Config.Name: Apple TV Art
Config.Description: true uses Apple TV key art as poster art when a title has it.

Config.Name: Only Rating Keys
Config.Description: Only handle these titles, for a first test. Empty means everything.

Config.Name: Minimum Video Badge
Config.Description: Lowest resolution that gets a badge: off, 720, 1080, 2160.

Config.Name: Minimum HDR Badge
Config.Description: Lowest HDR format that gets a badge: off, hdr10, hdr10plus, dolbyvision.

Config.Name: Minimum Audio Badge
Config.Description: Lowest audio that gets a badge: off, 5.1, 7.1, atmos.

Config.Name: Accessibility Badges
Config.Description: Any of sdh, cc, ad, separated by commas.

Config.Name: Status Labels
Config.Description: Labels such as JUST ADDED and NEW SEASON above the logo.

Config.Name: Episode Thumbnails
Config.Description: plain, titled or off.

Config.Name: Logo Languages
Config.Description: Title logo languages to try in order, such as fr,en.

Config.Name: Prefer Wordmark
Config.Description: Prefer a wide title logo over a square emblem.

Config.Name: Collection Posters
Config.Description: Posters for Plex collections too.

Config.Name: Service Collections
Config.Description: Keep one collection per streaming service in each TV library.

Config.Name: Sweep Minutes
Config.Description: How often to check for new and changed titles.

Config.Name: Daily Pass At
Config.Description: Time of the daily full pass, as HH:MM.

Config.Name: Heartbeat URL
Config.Description: An address to call every minute while healthy, such as an Uptime Kuma push URL.

Config.Name: Log Level
Config.Description: debug, info, warning or error.
